headline: Storage locations
headlineSub: Hierarchy of storage locations for holdings
trashPrompt: Select a storage location to restore or permanently delete it.
purgeConfirm: Permanently delete storage location "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
selectPrompt: Select a storage location or create a new one.

fieldTypeHelpPopover.title: Storage location type
fieldTypeHelpPopover.description: Classifies the storage location by kind (e.g. depot, shelf, drawer, display case). Enables type-specific extra fields and filtering storage locations by kind. New types are created under Configuration → Subtypes for "Storage locations".

deleteChildrenModal.title: Storage location has sub-locations
deleteChildrenModal.warning: This storage location has {{count}} direct sub-location.
deleteChildrenModal.warning_plural: This storage location has {{count}} direct sub-locations.
deleteChildrenModal.chooseAction: How should the sub-locations be handled?
deleteChildrenModal.optionReparentDesc: Sub-locations are reassigned to this location's own parent (or become top-level locations if this location had none).
deleteChildrenModal.optionCascadeDesc: The entire subtree is deleted, including all sub-locations.

errorVersionConflict: This storage location was changed by someone else in the meantime. Please reload and try again.
noObjects: No objects found at this location.
